newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: SIMEX Nikkei futures end lower but well supported.
newsitem.headline: SIMEX Nikkei futures end lower but well supported.

text.p: SIMEX Nikkei futures ended lower on Wednesday as the market struggled but failed to get above a key resistance level.
After reaching a high of 21,290, the benchmark Nikkei 225 December contract finished at 21,060 against its previous settlement at 21,210.
Dealers said the December Nikkei was well supported above the psychologically important 21,000-points level but players were looking for fresh good news to push it higher.
"The real test will come tomorrow. If it doesn't close above the 21,300 resistance level, it'll remain in its current range between 20,800 and 21,300," said a Japanese bank dealer.
He said the Nikkei could receive a much-sought boost from another record close on the Dow tonight if the U.S. Federal Reserve left interest rates steady at its policy-making meeting.
Dealers said a newspaper report of possible financial difficulties at Japan's Nippon Credit Bank had a mildly negative impact on the market.

The Asahi Shimbun said on Wednesday that Nippon Credit Bank's business could be affected by loan guarantees it had made to a financially-troubled non-bank unit. A spokesman for the bank later denied the report.
